messages:
Sana (Design): dropping a condensed Version History row here: https://www.figma.com/file/zz/compact-history. Goals: quick scan, inline rollback (reversible), and a subtle canary bar. looking for keyboard/a11y and copy notes.
Owen (PM): love the density. product asks: CTA should state target version (no ambiguous verbs). include a short undo TTL.
Theo (Eng): inline confirm ok. impl notes: make it a two-step (icon -> confirm) to avoid accidents. use list virtualization for long histories. when expanded, keep DOM toggles minimal to avoid layout thrash.
Lina (A11y): a11y: percent must remain in DOM (not hover-only). add aria-expanded on rows, aria-controls for details, and aria-live="polite" for status updates. ensure focus order: row -> timeline -> details -> rollback.
a11y-bot: automated scan: legend contrast fail (#8B9499 on #FFFFFF) ratio 2.7:1. recommend #3F4649.
Sana (Design): noted. copy options for CTA: "Rollback to v{X}", "Revert to v{X}", "Start rollback". leaning to first. will add helper text: "Undo available for 5 minutes."
Owen (PM): prefer "Rollback to v{X}" for clarity and logging. will run an A/B test against "Revert to v{X}".
Theo (Eng): technical: include version id in the DOM node for analytics. for keyboard we can show percent on focus with no layout shift using opacity trick, but keep it accessible to SRs.
Lina (A11y): please avoid visibility:hidden for SR content. keep percent readable by SRs and visually subdued until focus. also add role="status" to rollout progress so screen readers announce changes.
Sana (Design): action items: 1) update mock with explicit CTA "Rollback to v{X}" + helper line, 2) boost legend contrast to #3F4649, 3) annotate keyboard order and aria attributes. will post updated frames by EOD. :sparkles:
